Name: Golden Hour ( Window Light )
Author: Latteholn
Description:
"Golden Hour" is an aesthetic mod which transforms the standard window light into different window light styles.
+ New Variations Available!
- "SunCatcher" a vanilla-ish light with rainbow fairy hue
- "BlueHour" a depressed & blue-r version of moonshine

- Window lights change according to the time of day. 
- Two distinct configurable window light styles will appear in the game: one for morning (6:00 a.m - 3:00 p.m) and another for the afternoon (3:00 p.m - onwards)
- You can choose your preferred morning & afternoon window lights in the Config Menu.

This mod is for you if you want your farmhouse to look welcoming and bright or gloomy.

Mods used in the images:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17656]Dustbeauty's Industrial Furniture[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1074]Elegant Victorian Interior[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12240]Aster's Big Furniture Pack[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10473]Cozy Farmhouse Kitchen (Personally Modified)[/url]

[b]COMPATIBILITY[/b]
Should be compatible with different furniture mods, unless they also change the window lights.

[b]NOTES: [/b]
Version 1.0.2: "OnTimeChange", The change delays a bit when 3:00 pm occurs.
Version 1.0.3: "OnLocationChange", No Delays but you need to warp to other locations before the change occurs. ( e.g: Go to your cellar/Leave your house,, and then go back in again)
Version 1.0.4: "New Variations'!! (Golden Hour More Vibrant, SunCatcher, Blue Hour).
